text:
alexa: FYI PR #5123 is blocked by the CI SAST check - rule `sql-injection` flagged in `users_repository.go`. I think it's a false positive because we use parameterized queries.
mohit: can you paste the snippet? we need a repro to mark it as false pos
alexa: snippet:
```
db.Query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + userID)
```
This is in a test helper that constructs a prepared stmt earlier; not the actual production path.
security-bot: SAST Scanner v4.2 — finding: sql-injection (HIGH) in `helpers/test_db.go` — workflow: triage required — link: https://scans.internal/reports/5123
jordan: i'm wary of adding a bypass label. what if someone misuses it? prefer collecting an evidence bundle (test coverage, stacktrace, reviewer notes) and marking as `sast-evidence-attached`.
alexa: agreed evidence bundle makes sense. question — can we automate an audit-hook so when a reviewer marks it "evidence-accepted" the change is signed with our KMS key and logged to the audit index?
mohit: yes — we could add a GitHub action that calls our audit service and requests an HMAC signed token from KMS. do we need an HSM-backed signature or just KMS envelope?
triage: for compliance: HSM-backed signature preferred for exemptions > SLA threshold. smaller dev exemptions ok with KMS envelope + audit log
mohit: rough flow:
1) reviewer adds `sast-evidence-attached` label and comment `@security review:evidence=PR5123`.
2) GH Action runs a job `audit-sign` which calls `POST /audit/requests` with PR metadata.
3) audit service asks KMS to sign the payload and returns a signature blob stored in our audit index.
Example payload:
```
{"pr":5123,"rule":"sql-injection","decision":"accept","evidence_url":"https://..."}
```
security-bot: deployed prototype for `/audit/requests` on staging — use `audit-staging.redwood` for testing :rocket:
jordan: nice. make sure the signed payload contains the reviewer id and timestamp and we store the verifier chain so we can rotate keys without losing attestations.
alexa: also annotate the PR with the signature hash so CI shows it inline: `Audit-Signature: sha256:abcd...`
mohit: will prototype. i'll open infra ticket to add a short-lived service account that GH Actions can use to call the audit endpoint. will also add a retention policy for signature records.
triage: once prototype exists, security team will run 3 sample acceptances and verify audit logs + key rotation replay. then we can consider a limited rollback of the block for a whitelist flow.
alexa: perfect. i'll attach the test helper and coverage evidence to PR #5123 and label it `sast-evidence-attached` when done. will ping here when ready :thumbsup:
mohit: thanks — assign to me for the GH Action -> audit service integration.
security-bot: note: this thread will be archived after 30d of inactivity.
